<thought>From the 13C NMR data, the signals in the typical aromatic region (≈120‑150 ppm) are at 130.70, 130.27, 128.35, 126.66, 124.85, and 123.57 ppm, giving six aromatic carbon signals. The other signals correspond to carbonyl, aliphatic, etc., and are not aromatic. Therefore the molecule contains 6 aromatic carbons.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
